mood.label: RISK-ON
mood.summary: Markets are hitting record highs, fueled by strong tech and industrial earnings and a significant drop in oil prices on hopes of a U.S.-Iran deal. The tape is strong, but watch for signs of extension.

indicesNarrative: US indices are set for a strong open, with the S&P 500 hitting new intraday records, driven by a powerful rally in tech and industrial names. Falling Treasury yields and a sharp drop in oil prices are providing a significant tailwind, boosting broad market sentiment and risk appetite.
technicalsNarrative: With the S&P 500 pushing to new all-time highs, indices are in an EXTREME-EXTENDED state. Chasing new long entries here is dangerous due to overbought conditions. It is prudent to wait for a pullback or consolidation to establish a lower-risk entry.

sectorsNarrative: A clear risk-on rotation is underway, with money flowing into Technology and Industrials, fueled by strong earnings. Energy is the notable laggard due to the sharp drop in oil prices.
industryNarrative: Semiconductors and AI-related software are showing immense strength, with names like Palantir and Micron leading the charge. Heavy equipment and machinery are also outperforming on strong global demand signals from Caterpillar's report.

traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: The market is in a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend, but indices are extended. Not an ideal time to initiate new positions; focus on managing existing winners.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: Strong institutional flows into AI, Semis, and Industrials. This rotation has legs. Avoid the energy sector for now.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: The market is strong, but overbought. The posture is GO, but with caution. Do not chase extended names. Focus on A-grade setups like PLTR if a low-risk entry presents itself. Manage existing positions and raise stops.
